title: Tank equalizing valve (multi-agent)
description: an internal valve used for rapid equalization of tank pressure and downstream line pressure, which can be operated manually, by air, or by cable, and incorporates various valve mechanisms
reference_excerpt: The internal valve in question is classified under heading 8481 of the Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS), which covers taps, cocks, valves, and similar appliances. The classification process follows the General Rules of Interpretation (GRI), specifically GRI 1, which states that classification is determined by the terms of the headings and any relevant section or chapter notes. The internal valve does not fit the specific criteria for safety or relief valves outlined in subheading 8481.40.0000, as the essential character of the valve is not primarily safety-related but rather focused on its function of rapid pressure equalization. Therefore, GRI 3(b) cannot be applied.

text: {"heading":"8481","best_code":"8481.80.90.50","argument":"Heading 8481 covers 'Taps, cocks, valves and similar appliances, for pipes, boiler shells, tanks, vats or the like, including pressure-reducing valves and thermostatically controlled valves; parts thereof.' The product is an internal valve designed for rapid equalization of tank pressure and downstream line pressure, which is a core function of valves covered by this heading. The valve can be operated manually, by air, or by cable, incorporating various valve mechanisms. This multi-mode operation and pressure equalization function place it squarely within heading 8481's scope. The product is a complete valve unit (not a part), so it classifies under the main heading rather than 8481.90 (parts). Within 8481.80 (Other appliances), the valve does not fit the specific categories of pressure-reducing valves (8481.10), oleohydraulic/pneumatic transmission valves (8481.20), or check valves (8481.30), nor is it a safety/relief valve (8481.40). Under 8481.80.90 (Other appliances not otherwise specified), the valve's multi-mode actuation (manual, air, cable) and pressure equalization function best fit 8481.80.90.50 (Other), which captures valves with non-standard actuation mechanisms not covered by the more specific subcategories (solenoid, ballcock, regulator, control valves with hydraulic or thermostatic actuators). Chapter 84 note 1 does not exclude valves, and Section XVI note 1 does not exclude this product. The product is an internal valve designed for rapid equalization of tank pressure and downstream line pressure, which is a core function of valves covered by this heading. The valve can be operated manually, by air, or by cable, incorporating various valve mechanisms. This multi-mode operation and pressure equalization function place it squarely within heading 8481's scope. The product is a complete valve unit (not a part), so it classifies under the main heading rather than 8481.90 (parts). Within 8481.80 (Other appliances), the valve does not fit the specific categories of pressure-reducing valves (8481.10), oleohydraulic/pneumatic transmission valves (8481.20), or check valves (8481.30), nor is it a safety/relief valve (8481.40). Under 8481.80.90 (Other appliances not otherwise specified), the valve's multi-mode actuation (manual, air, cable) and pressure equalization function best fit 8481.80.90.50 (Other), which captures valves with non-standard actuation mechanisms not covered by the more specific subcategories (solenoid, ballcock, regulator, control valves with hydraulic or thermostatic actuators). Chapter 84 note 1 does not exclude valves, and Section XVI note 1 does not exclude this product. The product is not a part or accessory but a complete appliance suitable for use in industrial fluid systems.
